project: WS4 — Short-Form Pipeline, Personal Site & YouTube
description: Research short-form tools, build content converter POC, personal site alignment, YouTube channel strategy

userStories.title: Research Short-Form Conversion Tools & Methods
userStories.description: Research tools and approaches for converting long-form video (6-7 min) and audio (13 min) into short-form social content (<60 sec clips, quote cards, carousel posts).
acceptanceCriteria: tasks/ws4-shortform/tool-research.md exists with comprehensive report
At least 5 tools evaluated with pros/cons/pricing
Covers: AI clip extraction, manual editing, avatar-based summarization
Recommended approach for Deeperfire AI content specifically
Estimated time per conversion (manual vs automated)
userStories.notes: Jake has 6-7 min videos and 13 min audio from NotebookLM dev journals. Needs social-length clips.

userStories.title: Build Short-Form Conversion Skill (POC)
userStories.description: Build a proof-of-concept skill that takes long-form content and produces short-form outputs: highlight clips, quote cards, LinkedIn text summary.
acceptanceCriteria: skills/content-converter/SKILL.md exists with skill documentation
skills/content-converter/scripts/extract-highlights.py exists and is syntactically valid
Script accepts: transcript text input, outputs: highlight segments with timestamps, quote cards, LinkedIn summary
README documents input/output format and how to run
At least one example output included in skills/content-converter/examples/
userStories.notes: Build on existing skills. This is a POC — transcript-based extraction first, video editing later.

userStories.title: Personal Site & CV Alignment Audit
userStories.description: Audit Jake's personal site repo. Ensure content matches current CV, links to Deepify AI and Deeperfire AI, is ready for recruiters/clients if needed.
acceptanceCriteria: tasks/ws4-shortform/personal-site-audit.md exists with full audit
Current site content documented (what exists, what's missing)
Action items list: what needs updating to match current CV
Link strategy: how personal site connects to Deepify AI, Deeperfire AI, YouTube
Mobile responsiveness noted
Recommendations for blog integration (Daily Avatars or similar)
userStories.notes: Jake mentioned personal site as professional anchor / safety net if employment changes.

userStories.title: YouTube Channel Strategy & Setup Plan
userStories.description: Define Deepify YouTube channel strategy. Content split vs LinkedIn. Branding, playlists, upload plan.
acceptanceCriteria: tasks/ws4-shortform/youtube-strategy.md exists with full strategy
Content strategy: what goes on YouTube vs LinkedIn vs website
Playlist structure defined (e.g. Dev Journals, R&D Showcases, Tutorials)
Branding recommendations (banner, profile, description copy drafted)
First 5 video upload plan with titles, descriptions, thumbnails concepts
YouTube SEO basics included (tags, descriptions, keywords)
userStories.notes: Jake called YouTube the 'HQ' for Deepify content. Separate from LinkedIn (Deeperfire AI).
